name: auto_fax
description: Auto-fax on note lock: when a note is locked or signed, faxes it to the recipients a practice's rules name (an external care team member such as the PCP or referring provider, the patient's facility, or a fixed number). Rules, a dry-run mode and a test fax number are set in the plugin's settings. For practice admins and care coordinators who fax visit notes by hand today.

protocols.description: On a note state change to locked, signed or relocked, faxes the note to each recipient the matching rules name.
